visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, wavy dark hair and polished makeup stands against a neutral gray background. She holds a small, yellow and white plush character with tiny black horns towards the camera, first out of focus and then bringing it closer. She smiles slightly, her eyes looking at the plush, then brings the toy to her lips and kisses its side multiple times, demonstrating the lack of transfer from her red lipstick. (2) The scene cuts to her holding a rectangular red lipstick tube labeled "VINYL" near her face. Bold white text overlays appear as she maintains direct eye contact with the camera. The studio-style lighting is bright and even, highlighting her clear skin, defined eyelashes, and the glossy finish of her lip makeup. (3) A sequence of close-ups shows her interacting with the product. She shakes the red tube vigorously with her right hand to activate the formula. Then, in an extreme close-up of her mouth, she applies a reddish-orange glossy liquid to her lower lip using a small applicator wand. She presses her lips together slightly. Afterward, she picks up a clear glass with a blue decorative motif, takes a sip, and shows the clean rim of the glass to the lens. (4) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the woman in various poses, each featuring a different shade of the liquid lipstick. Text overlays indicate specific shade numbers. She touches her face, smiles, and pouts to demonstrate the different colors and textures. A split-screen shot compares a full-color application with a blurred, finger-smudged look. (5) The camera shows a close-up of a person's inner forearm with seven distinct rectangular swatches of lipstick in varying shades of red, pink, and orange. White text labels identify each shade. The video then transitions to a high-angle shot of several red lipstick tubes scattered on a white surface. Finally, she holds a pinkish tube near her chin, smiling warmly as more descriptive text appears on the screen.

No human speech or incidental noises are audible. (2) The background music continues with consistent energy and tempo, maintaining a bright spectral profile. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Maybelline's Super Stay Vinyl Ink liquid lipsticks by demonstrating their long-lasting, transfer-proof qualities using a plush toy and a glass test, and by showcasing a range of vibrant colors through professional swatching and model applications.
